# ash_ai v0.7.2 - Table of Contents

> Integrated LLM features for your Ash application.

- [Home](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Gemini](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/gemini.md)

  - [AshAi](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashai.md)

- About AshGraphql
  - [Change Log](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [AshAi](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.md): Documentation for `AshAi`.

- [AshAi.Actions](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Actions.md): Builtin generic action implementations.
- [AshAi.Actions.Prompt](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Actions.Prompt.md): A generic action impl that returns structured outputs from an LLM matching the action return.
- [AshAi.Actions.Prompt.FlowState](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Actions.Prompt.FlowState.md): Internal ReqLLM-native flow state for prompt actions.
- [AshAi.Changes.Vectorize](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Changes.Vectorize.md): A change that vectorizes the current values of attributes for a given record.
Used by the manual vectorization strategy, so you can decide
later when to run the vectorization action.

- [AshAi.Changes.VectorizeAfterAction](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Changes.VectorizeAfterAction.md): Vectorizes attributes inline immediately after they are changed
- [AshAi.Changes.VectorizeAfterActionObanTrigger](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Changes.VectorizeAfterActionObanTrigger.md): Run an ash_oban trigger when embeddings need to be regenerated.
- [AshAi.ChatUI.Tools](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ChatUI.Tools.md): Normalizes tool call and tool result data for generated chat UIs.
- [AshAi.Checks.ActorIsAshAi](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Checks.ActorIsAshAi.md): A check that is true when the actor is `%AshAi{}`
- [AshAi.Dsl](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Dsl.md): Spark DSL schemas and configuration for AshAi.
- [AshAi.EmbeddingModel](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.EmbeddingModel.md): A behaviour that defines the dimensions of the vector, and how to generate the embedding

- [AshAi.EmbeddingModels.ReqLLM](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.EmbeddingModels.ReqLLM.md): ReqLLM-backed embedding model for AshAi vectorization.
- [AshAi.FullText](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.FullText.md): A section that defines how complex vectorized columns are defined
- [AshAi.Info](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Info.md): Introspection functions for the `AshAi` extension.
- [AshAi.Mcp](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Mcp.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation for Ash Framework.
- [AshAi.Mcp.Dev](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Mcp.Dev.md): Place in your endpoint's code_reloading section to expose Ash dev MCP"
- [AshAi.Mcp.Router](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Mcp.Router.md): MCP Router implementing the RPC functionality over HTTP.
- [AshAi.Mcp.Server](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Mcp.Server.md): Implementation of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) RPC functionality.
- [AshAi.McpResource](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.McpResource.md): An MCP resource to expose via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- [AshAi.McpUiResource](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.McpUiResource.md): A UI resource for MCP Apps (Model Context Protocol Apps extension).
- [AshAi.ToToolError](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToToolError.md): Converts Ash errors into concise readable tool error messages.
- [AshAi.Tool](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.md): An action exposed to LLM agents
- [AshAi.Tool.Argument](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Argument.md): A struct representing an argument defined in the Tool DSL.

- [AshAi.Tool.Builder](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Builder.md): Builds ReqLLM.Tool structs and callbacks from AshAi.Tool DSL entities.
- [AshAi.Tool.Errors](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Errors.md): Formats Ash errors into human-readable text for tool responses.
- [AshAi.Tool.Execution](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Execution.md): Executes Ash actions from tool call arguments.

- [AshAi.Tool.Execution.Context](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Execution.Context.md): Execution context for tool calls.

- [AshAi.Tool.Schema](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tool.Schema.md): Generates JSON schemas for tool parameters.
- [AshAi.ToolEndEvent](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToolEndEvent.md): Event data passed to the `on_tool_end` callback used by `AshAi.ToolLoop`.
- [AshAi.ToolLoop](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToolLoop.md): Manages a ReqLLM conversation loop with tool calls.
- [AshAi.ToolLoop.IterationEvent](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToolLoop.IterationEvent.md): Event emitted at the start of each iteration in the tool loop.

- [AshAi.ToolLoop.Result](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToolLoop.Result.md): Result returned from a completed tool loop.
- [AshAi.ToolStartEvent](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.ToolStartEvent.md): Event data passed to the `on_tool_start` callback used by `AshAi.ToolLoop`.
- [AshAi.Tools](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Tools.md): High-level API for discovering and building tools from Ash domains.
- [AshAi.Validations.ActorIsAshAi](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Validations.ActorIsAshAi.md): A validation that passes if the actor is `%AshAi{}`
- [AshAi.Verifiers.McpResourceActionsReturnString](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/AshAi.Verifiers.McpResourceActionsReturnString.md): Verifies that all MCP resource actions return strings.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_ai.gen.chat](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshAi.Gen.Chat.md): Generates the resources and views for a conversational UI backed by `ash_postgres` and `ash_oban`
- [mix ash_ai.gen.mcp](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshAi.Gen.Mcp.md): Sets up an MCP server for your application
- [mix ash_ai.install](https://ash-ai.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshAi.Install.md): Installs `AshAi`. Call with `mix igniter.install ash_ai`. Requires igniter to run.
